test_calculate_mavrin_cooling_rate: test the radiation.calculate_mavrin_cooling_rate function with coronal and noncoronal model types for various ions
test_calculate_cooling_rate: test the radiation.calculate_cooling_rate function that blends coronal and noncoronal models based on temperature and ne_tau
test_temperature_clipping: test that radiation.calculate_mavrin_cooling_rate clips electron temperature to the model validity range
test_ne_tau_clipping: test that radiation.calculate_mavrin_cooling_rate caps ne_tau at the coronal limit for noncoronal model
test_helium_isotope_equivalence: test that He3 and He4 produce identical cooling rates to He in both coronal and noncoronal models
